Messages.Author: legb...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
i feel a rush of creativity coming on, but before i get stuck into deck
building i want to check up on how masochism works with things like
Charnas the Imp, Rutor's Hand and Talbot's Chainsaw. Both the imp and
chainsaw inflict damage, so i assume this is converted to rush counters,
similarly for the Hand if you omit to pay the extra blood to prevent the
damage. The basic idea is of course to deliberately put Charnas on your
OWN masochistic minions, who then rush about doing spectacularly
expensive things for free, or cheap, anyway. i was thinking of trying
this with the tremere, maybe with a touch of chimerstry for extra
amusement value. Now someone is going to tell me that there is a ruling
that only combat damage gets converted to rush counters. Sp

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

I might be tempted to include Patrizia Giovanni (since she has
thaumaturgy) in order to allow you to bring out Ambrosius, maybe. That
way, you can do the damage thing on him if it gets to a point whereby you
don't have the blood to afford it on your vampires.

Of course, Chantry is likely to be highly useful in the deck as well.
